eps.ov: Takamine is basically a goddess. Shirota is like an NPC, but he glimpses her bare breasts. Weirdness ensues...

eps.t: Let Me Redo It Until I'm Satisfied.
eps.ov: It's Shirota's first day as Takamine's closet. How is he even supposed to pull off what she's asking of him?

eps.t: I Want You to Enjoy the Very Best
eps.ov: Shirota learns how much effort Takamine has put in to be who she is. Later she helps him get first place.
When Shirota gets sick, Takamine nurses him with surprising devotion, making him wonder if it means something.

eps.t: I Want You to Make This Cat Purr, Meow.
eps.ov: Shirota is over at Takamine's place, but then the lightning knocks out the power and sends her into his arms.

eps.t: Honey, Let Me Wash Your Back.
eps.ov: Takamine and Shirota roleplay newly-weds. She escalates things by joining him in the bath to wash his back.

eps.t: Even That Which Isn't Visible From There
eps.ov: Takamine and Shirota talk about the future. When he says he's set on work, not college, she briefly looks sad.
Shirota runs into Ellie, a friend from grade school. They're hanging out in the park where Takamine sees them.
Takamine challenges Shirota to a water balloon fight, the loser has to obey the winner. What will it be?

eps.t: It Rains, and Shirota Freezes Up
eps.ov: The class will put on the play Cinderella. Naturally, Takamine will be Cinderella, but who will be the prince?

eps.t: I'll Let You Do a Dry Run
eps.ov: To calm Shirota's nerves, Takamine goes into the haunted house with him. It works, but now where is Ouji?
Can Shirota make it to the end of Cinderella without messing up? Near the end, something unexpected happens!
